common.slogan: Lost something at UM? Just miaUM.

footer.about: Lost and found for the University of Minho community. It points items to the official drop-off points and protects everyone's privacy.
footer.independent: Independent project. Not an official University of Minho service.
footer.provisional: Development version: drop-off points and opening hours are example data.

home.title: University of Minho lost and found
home.intro: Found something or lost something on campus? Post it here and we'll help get it back to its owner, simply and safely.

1.title: Post
1.text: Whoever loses or finds an item describes it, the campus and the place.

2.title: We find matches
2.text: The app suggests similar posts automatically and notifies the owner.

3.title: Collect it safely
3.text: The owner claims the item and is told where to pick it up.

home.privacyText: The public only sees where and when an item was found. The drop-off location and contacts are revealed only to the person who claims it.
home.oldNotice: Lost something more than 30 days ago? Ask directly at the drop-off points.
home.howText: Three steps to get an item back to its owner.

login.title: Sign in to miaUM
login.intro: Use your university email. We'll send you a link that expires in 15 minutes, no password needed.
login.checkText: If the email is valid, you'll receive a sign-in link. It may take a few minutes; check your spam folder too.
login.checkHint: You can close this page. The link opens the app already signed in.

errors.AccessDenied: This email can't be used. Please use your university email.
errors.Verification: The link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.limite: Too many links requested. Try again in an hour.
errors.default: Couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

report.lostIntro: Describe the item and where you last saw it. We'll show you similar posts right away.
report.foundIntro: Thanks for helping! In three steps the item becomes visible to whoever lost it.

custody.POINT: Handed in at a drop-off point
custody.POINT_campus: Handed in at a drop-off point in {campus}

report.publishedLostText: We'll let you know when a similar item turns up.
report.publishedFoundText: Whoever lost this item can now find it.
report.finderKeeps: You kept the item. Whoever claims it will get these contacts:
report.privateDetails: Private details (only you and the desk can see them)
report.manageSoon: Editing and closing posts will soon be available in "My posts".
report.sawItText: Post what you found. We'll prefill the form with this post's category, campus and colour.
report.isItYoursText: When you claim it, you'll be told where to pick it up. Ownership is confirmed at the desk.
report.claimSoon: Claiming items will be available in the next update.
report.neverPublic: The exact location of the item, private details and contacts are never public.

welcome.title: What's your name?
welcome.intro: We only need your first name. It's shown at the pick-up desk and in chats, never your email.
welcome.label: First name
welcome.hint: We only keep the first word.
welcome.invalidName: Enter a valid first name (letters only).

reportForm.whatText: The more specific, the easier it is to recognise.
reportForm.descriptionHint: At least 10 characters. Don't include personal data (names, ID numbers).
reportForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Black backpack with an AAUM sticker and a yellow keyring…
reportForm.whenLostText: Give the window between when you last saw it and when you noticed it was missing.
reportForm.privateDetailsText: Never published. Only you and the drop-off point staff can see them.
reportForm.privateDetailsLabel: Something only the owner would know
reportForm.privateDetailsPlaceholder: What's inside, stickers, lock screen… Helps the desk confirm the owner.
reportForm.publicNotice: The post stays public for 30 days, without your contact details.
reportForm.previewTitle: This is how the public will see your post
reportForm.previewText: Make sure no personal data is visible before publishing.

found.startTitle: Have you already handed the item in at an official drop-off point?
found.startText: It's the safest way for the item to reach its owner.
found.noText: See how you can help the item reach its owner.
found.encourageTitle: Handing it in at an official point is the best option
found.encourageText: It is the safest and fastest way for the item to reach its owner, and you will not have to worry about it.
found.pointTitle: Where did you (or will you) hand it in?
found.pointText: Only whoever claims the item sees this place.
found.finderWarning: You are responsible for arranging the return with whoever claims it. Whenever you can, hand it in at an official point.
found.finderAccept: I agree to be responsible for the item and for these contacts to be shown to whoever claims it.
found.encourageExamples: For example: building gatehouses and receptions, library desks or the academic services.
found.willDeliverText: Say where you will leave it.
found.proceed: I cannot hand it in, continue
found.proceedText: You keep the item and whoever claims it gets your contact.
found.pointHint: Type freely or pick a suggestion.
found.pointLinked: Known point: its staff will see the item.
found.pointPrivate: This place is only shown to whoever claims the item.
found.contactTitle: Whoever claims the item will see your university email:
found.contactHint: For example, your phone. Only shown to whoever claims the item.
